Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant with advanced reasoning capabilities.
Models: see ClaudeClient.VALID_MODELS and the provider's default_model. This field deliberately does not list them. It carried a "Latest Models (October 2025)" block naming Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5 and Opus 4.1 long after those stopped being latest, because a description loaded noupdate="1" is written once and read for years while the model line moves every few months. A fourth copy of the model list, and the one nothing could correct.
Features: - 1M token context window (with beta header: anthropic-beta: context-1m-2025-08-07) - Vision capabilities (images, PDFs, base64, URLs) - Extended thinking mode for complex reasoning - Tool use for structured outputs and function calling - Guaranteed valid JSON via tool use (structured_output method) - Alternative JSON via prefilling (json_completion method) - Prompt caching for optimized repeated context usage - Batch API for bulk processing
For current pricing information, visit: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing
Use Cases: - Complex agent building and automation - Code generation and review - Document understanding and summarization (vision + PDF) - Agentic workflows with tool use - Multi-turn conversations with vision - Data extraction with structured_output (production) - Simple JSON with json_completion (quick tasks) - Complex reasoning with extended thinking
ClaudeClient Methods (Phase 1 - Quick Wins): - create_message() - Full API control with vision, thinking, tools - simple_completion() - Quick text generation - vision_completion() - Analyze images - structured_output() - Guaranteed JSON with schema validation - json_completion() - Simple JSON via prefilling - vision_structured_output() - Extract data from images - streaming_completion() - Stream responses - get_usage() - Track token usage
ClaudeClient Methods (Phase 2 - Advanced): - create_cacheable_content() - Create cached content blocks - create_cached_system_prompt() - Cached system prompts for optimization - tool_conversation() - Agentic workflows with tool use - enable_extended_context() - Enable 1M token context window
ClaudeClient Methods (Phase 3 - PDF Support): - pdf_completion() - Analyze PDF documents (text, tables, charts) - pdf_structured_output() - Extract validated data from PDFs - pdf_with_caching() - Multi-question PDF analysis with optimization
Real-World Use Cases: - Chatbots with cached guidelines (optimized token usage) - AI agents that query Odoo database (tool use) - Full module code analysis (extended context) - Invoice OCR with structured extraction (vision + structured output) - PDF invoice/contract processing (pdf_structured_output) - Multi-step workflows (tool conversation) - Document understanding at scale (extended context + caching) - Batch PDF processing (100s of documents) - Interactive PDF Q&A (pdf_with_caching)

DeepSeek provides powerful AI models for various tasks.
Models Available: - deepseek-chat (standard model for general tasks) - deepseek-coder (specialized for code generation and analysis) - deepseek-vision (vision-language model for OCR and image analysis) - 128K token context window
Features: - DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) for efficiency - Built-in reasoning capabilities (not exposed as separate field) - Vision and OCR capabilities (100+ languages supported) - Enhanced agent capabilities - OpenAI-compatible API format - Function calling / tool use support - JSON mode for structured output - Excellent for mathematical and coding tasks - MIT License (model is open-source)
Vision/OCR Capabilities: - Text extraction from images (OCR) - Document layout detection - Caption generation - Visual question answering - Support for JPEG, PNG, WEBP formats - Maximum recommended resolution: 1024px - Structured data extraction from invoices/receipts/forms
For current pricing information, visit: https://platform.deepseek.com/
DeepSeekClient Methods (15 total): - chat_completion() - Full API control with messages - simple_completion() - Quick text generation - code_completion() - Use deepseek-coder model for coding tasks - streaming_completion() - Stream responses in real-time - structured_output() - Guaranteed JSON with schema validation via function calling - json_completion() - Simple JSON via response_format parameter - get_usage() - Token usage tracking - reasoning_completion() - Enhanced prompt for complex reasoning (uses deepseek-chat) - tool_conversation() - Multi-turn agentic workflows with function calling - streaming_json_completion() - Stream structured JSON output - math_completion() - Optimized prompts for mathematical problems - code_review() - Structured code feedback with DeepSeek Coder - vision_completion() - Analyze images with deepseek-vision model - ocr_completion() - Extract text from images (OCR) - vision_structured_output() - Extract structured JSON data from images
Note: DeepSeek has built-in reasoning but does NOT expose separate reasoning fields in API responses.
Use Cases: - Code generation and analysis (deepseek-coder) - Mathematical reasoning (deepseek-chat with optimized prompts) - OCR and document processing (deepseek-vision) - Invoice/receipt data extraction (vision_structured_output) - Structured data extraction (structured_output) - AI agents with Odoo integration (tool_conversation) - Bulk text processing - Technical documentation - Code review and analysis - Long conversation workflows
When to Use DeepSeek vs Claude: - Use DeepSeek for: Math, coding, OCR, invoice processing, bulk operations - Use Claude for: Native PDF processing (without OCR), extremely complex reasoning, long context (>128K), prompt caching - Use Both: DeepSeek for general tasks, Claude for advanced features requiring caching/PDFs
Limitations: - No native PDF processing (requires OCR first or PDF-to-image conversion) - No prompt caching feature - No batch API - Reasoning is internal only (no separate reasoning field in responses) - Vision resolution limit: 1024px recommended

OpenAI's GPT models for various AI tasks.
Latest Models (October 2025): - GPT-4.1 family (gpt-4.1, gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-4.1-nano) - Released April 2025 - o4-mini - Fast reasoning model - GPT-5 - Released August 2025 - GPT-4o - Still available, reliable choice
Features: - GPT-4.1 outperforms GPT-4o across all benchmarks - Major improvements in coding and instruction following - DALL-E for image generation - Whisper for speech-to-text - TTS for text-to-speech - Embeddings and fine-tuning - Function calling
Model Recommendations: - Use GPT-4.1 for best quality - Use gpt-4.1-mini for balanced cost/performance - Use o4-mini for reasoning tasks
Use Cases: - Conversational AI - Content creation - Code assistance - Translation - Summarization - Image generation

Google's most capable AI model with multimodal capabilities.
Latest Models (October 2025): - Gemini 2.5 Flash (gemini-2.5-flash-preview-09-2025) - Updated Oct 15, 2025 - Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite - Most cost-efficient and fastest - Gemini 2.5 Pro - Most capable for complex tasks
Features: - 2 million token context window (largest available) - Native multimodal (text, images, audio, video) - Improved agentic tool use (+5% on SWE-Bench) - More cost-efficient thinking mode - Use -latest alias for automatic updates - Free tier available
Improvements (Oct 2025): - Better tool use for complex agentic applications - Optimized token usage with thinking enabled - Lower latency - Enhanced multi-step reasoning
FREE tier available with generous quotas. For current pricing information, visit: https://ai.google.dev/pricing
Use Cases: - Long document analysis (2M tokens!) - Multimodal applications (images, video, audio) - Complex agentic workflows - Real-time streaming - Code generation and review - Large-scale data processing

Industry-leading speech recognition and audio intelligence platform.
Core Capabilities: - Speech-to-Text: Pre-recorded and real-time streaming transcription - Text-to-Speech: Natural voice synthesis with multiple voices - Audio Intelligence: Summarization, sentiment, topics, entities, intents - Multi-language: Support for 30+ languages with code-switching - Speaker Diarization: Identify and separate different speakers
Key Features: - Multiple transcription models for different use cases - Advanced audio intelligence and insights - PII redaction and content filtering - Custom vocabulary and keyword boosting - Real-time WebSocket streaming - High accuracy with low latency - Enterprise-grade reliability
Use Cases: - Call center analytics and quality monitoring - Meeting transcription and insights - Media and podcast transcription - Voice-enabled applications - Compliance and legal documentation
For current features, models, and pricing: https://deepgram.com API Documentation: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs
